info.title: HOTEL PMS implemented Phase 4 property and resource contract
info.description: Implemented-only contract for P04 property groups, properties, locations, resource types and resources. Operations listed here exist in apps/api; planned V1 operations remain in v1.openapi.json and are not implied running. Property scoped routes require the x-property-ref header only when the acting grant is limited to selected properties; tenant isolation is enforced by runtime role RLS in addition to Application policy.

session.name: hotel_session
session.description: HttpOnly server-side session cookie; tokens are never placed in browser storage.

TenantId.name: tenantId
TenantId.description: Must match the active tenant recorded in the server-side session.

Error.description: Fixed error code, localized message key, correlation id and bounded details without secrets

parent_resource_id.description: Physical parent resource. Create only: ROOM under an existing ACTIVE VILLA already containing ROOM children; does not convert atomic whole-only inventory.

sharing_scope.description: Sharing policy for bed products created by the setup wizard; null means not a shared-room product.

secret_ref.description: Reference such as secret:name or vault:path; raw secrets are rejected.

internal_rate_ref.description: Rate plan mapping is completed in P05-01.

LocationTreeNodeV2.description: PSR-03 tree extension. Scoped parent, maximum depth 32; PATCH omission preserves, null detaches. Sort display_order/code/id.

LocationTreeUpdateV2.description: PSR-03 tree extension. Scoped parent, maximum depth 32; PATCH omission preserves, null detaches. Sort display_order/code/id.

LocationTreePageV2.description: PSR-03 tree extension. Scoped parent, maximum depth 32; PATCH omission preserves, null detaches. Sort display_order/code/id.

ArchiveImpact.description: Read-only direct relationship counts scoped to the tenant/property. Historical relations are preserved and do not by themselves block resource retirement. Location children/resources and resource children, live commitments, open stays and unreleased channel exposure block archiving. A preview grants no permission to write; PATCH rechecks versions and relations under the property lock.

200.description: Property groups in the active tenant
Property updated with status transition checks

schema.description: UUID or root; only with tree=true

get.description: Legacy flat list unchanged. In tree=true mode, q is literal case-insensitive substring on code/name, kind filters an existing location kind, sort is ascending display_order/code/id (default), code/id or name/code/id. All search/filter/sort parameters require tree=true. Cursor binds scope, parent, query, kind, order and tree revision; reject 400 on mismatch and 412 after mutation. Search applies to children of the specified parent.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required if any parent_id, kind or display_order field is present. Legacy flat create remains compatible.

422.description: LOCATION_IN_USE; details contain scoped blockers and counts

patch.description: Changing an ACTIVE location to INACTIVE refuses children or resource relations. Rechecks under the property lock with optimistic version; no deletion or cascade.

200.description: Resources in the property ordered by creation keyset

412.description: Search inventory revision changed; restart the first page.

get.description: Scoped unit pages. With search/filter/sort: literal case-insensitive substring q over code, display_label and unit_details.notes; attributes are existing resource type, capacity and descriptive bedrooms/bathrooms. Ascending sort plus UUID tie breaker, null label falls back to code. Omitted filters retain legacy created_at/id order and cursor. Search cursors are HMAC authenticated, bound to scope/query/filters/order/inventory revision, and invalidated by relevant writes or API restart. Cursor mismatch is 400; changed revision is 412. No dynamic attribute engine.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required for a non-null parent_resource_id; durable child creation replay only. Legacy standalone creation is unchanged.

422.description: RESOURCE_IN_USE; details contain scoped blockers and counts

patch.description: Changing a resource to INACTIVE or RETIRED refuses structural children, live/future commitments, open stays and unreleased channel exposures including UNKNOWN; historical allocations and product/composition links alone are preserved and do not block retirement. Rechecks under the property lock with optimistic version; no deletion or cascade.

get.description: Returns counts and blockers only. No guest data, write, deletion or cascading archive. Resource live commitments include unexpired holds; channel UNKNOWN remains blocking until withdrawal is proven.

query.parent_id: UUID or root; tree=true with omitted parent reads roots. Without tree=true use legacy flat list.
query.cursor: opaque signed/scoped cursor; binds parent/order/tree revision; stale cursor rejected

ListLocations.response: LocationTreePageV2 only when tree=true; legacy LocationList otherwise

x-psr-location-tree.cursor_lifetime: Invalidated by tree mutation or API process restart; clients restart at the root/page one.
